record.paper_title: Open problems in queueing theory inspired by datacenter computing
record.original_question: How can one analyze the M/G/k queue with setup times, where service times are general rather than exponential and idle servers may shut down and later require setup before returning to service?

evidence.quote: Finally, the M/G/k system with setup time is also a wide open problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider an M/G/k queueing system with setup times defined as follows. Jobs arrive according to a Poisson process of rate λ to a system with k identical parallel servers. Job service requirements are i.i.d. samples from a general distribution G with finite mean 1/μ (not necessarily exponential). Each server is in one of three states: BUSY (serving a job), OFF (powered down), or SETUP (powering up). When a server completes a job and finds no waiting jobs, it immediately switches to the OFF state. When a job arrives and finds at least one server in the OFF state (and no idle BUSY-eligible server), one OFF server is switched to SETUP; after an i.i.d. setup time drawn from a given distribution S, that server becomes available and begins serving a waiting job (if any remain). Assume ρ = λ/(kμ) < 1 for stability.

Provide an exact analysis of this M/G/k queue with setup times: in particular, derive the stationary distribution of the number of jobs in the system, or equivalently the mean response time E[T], as a function of λ, k, the service-time distribution G, and the setup-time distribution S.
artifact.status_search_result: The M/G/k queue with setup times remains a wide open problem. Existing analyses cover M/M/k with exponential setup times (closed-form decomposition results) and recent work on M/M/k with deterministic setup times (bounds rather than exact analysis), but no exact analysis of the fully general M/G/k with general setup times has appeared.

status_evidence.title: M/G/k with Exponential Setup (Gandhi & Harchol-Balter)
status_evidence.snippet: Closed-form analysis given for M/M/k with exponential setup times; general service distribution case not solved.
status_evidence.claim: Only the exponential-service, exponential-setup case has a closed-form solution.

status_evidence.title: An Upper Bound on the M/M/k Queue With Deterministic Setup Times
status_evidence.snippet: Provides multiplicatively-tight upper and lower bounds on mean waiting time for M/M/k with deterministic setup times — the first closed-form bounds for any many-server system with setup times.
status_evidence.claim: Even M/M/k with deterministic setup times only admits bounds, not exact analysis, indicating M/G/k with setup is still open.

status_evidence.title: Setup Times in Multiserver Systems (Williams, CMU PhD thesis, 2024)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys multiserver setup-time models and presents new bounds; exact M/G/k-with-setup analysis is not given.
status_evidence.claim: Recent thesis confirms M/G/k with setup remains unresolved in exact form.
